notes_body: FROZEN encoder + FaceRhythm, lick window (first post-cue lick -0.1..+1.0 s), Allen areas. Each group ALONE (single-group model; Musall et al. 2019 layout): full, task, instructed (lick group), uninstructed (other movement: nose, running, pose; FaceRhythm not in it), spout, movement. R2 split into PETH (per-spout trial averages) and trial-by-trial (variability around them). Rows: pre PETH level, pre trial-by-trial level, then acute - pre and chronic - pre (each animal's own pre) for PETH and for trial-by-trial. Trial-by-trial: no significant change in the full model in either epoch; acutely lick alone rises in 35 areas and spout alone in 30 (task alone 8 down, movement 1 up), none significant chronically. Lick alone has PETH R2 <= 0 by construction (its regressors are deviations from each spout's template).
